description: Mapping objection (Scholze and Stix) to response (Mochizuki) to formal proof obligation for IUT III, Corollary 3.12. Layers: objection text is what Scholze and Stix say; response text is what Mochizuki says; all other fields are the assessment of this project. No winner is declared.

sources.title: P. Scholze, J. Stix, Why abc is still a conjecture
sources.note: Matches the version Mochizuki calls SS2018-08. The May 2018 version SS2018-05 was not available.

sources.title: S. Mochizuki, Report on Discussions, Held During the Period March 15 to 20, 2018, Concerning IUTch
S. Mochizuki, Comments on the Manuscript by Scholze-Stix Concerning IUTch
sources.note: Answers SS2018-05; its footnote and remark numbers follow that version.

sources.title: S. Mochizuki, Comments on the Manuscript (2018-08 Version) by Scholze-Stix Concerning IUTch

sources.note: Scholze and Stix quote an earlier version of Step (xi) whose wording does not occur in this version.

obligations.OB-RED: Real analysis from Claim 6, (1.2), (1.3) to Vojta's inequality with O(1). Done: IUT.Audit.ScholzeStix.vojta_of_claim6 (needs N >= 0; no finiteness statement).
obligations.OB-HT: Precise statement of the category of Theta^{+-ell}NF-Hodge theaters (with l and V) and of its relation to the curve X.
obligations.OB-LOG: Definition of the log-link with distinguished domain and codomain, and the (non)invariance of the Theta-link under identifying them (Mochizuki's question (Q3)).
obligations.OB-IND: Lean definitions of (Ind1), (Ind2), (Ind3) and of full poly-isomorphisms, and a proof or refutation that Theorem 3.11 needs them.
obligations.OB-DEF: Lean definition of -|log(Theta)| and -|log(q)| from initial Theta-data (procession-normalized mono-analytic log-volume of the holomorphic hull of possible images), IUT III pages 173 to 174.
obligations.OB-311-HYP: Exact hypotheses of IUT III, Theorem 3.11, in particular whether the value group and unit group portions of the Theta-link domain must come from one ring structure ((ThetaCR)); decides whether the id-version (SSId) is admissible.
obligations.OB-XI-CONTAINER: Step (xi-b) to (xi-d): that the output possibilities and the q-pilot representation lie in one container 1,o U^Q with one log-volume, so that no cycle of identifications of copies of R must commute.
obligations.OB-XI-F: Step (xi-e), (xi-f): that -|log(q)| lies in R_{<= -|log(Theta)|}, i.e. that the multiradial construction constitutes (up to indeterminacies) a construction of the input pilot log-volume. The formal last step is IUT.Audit.MochizukiResponses.ToyModels.stepXIf_formal; the membership itself is unformalized.
obligations.OB-IND-SIZE: Quantitative effect of (Ind1), (Ind2), (Ind3) on log-volumes (IUT IV, Proposition 1.2 and Theorem 1.10), to compare with the factor l(l+1)/12 of IUT.Audit.ScholzeStix.avgSq_eq.

pairs.objection: SS-5, SS-3: reduction to Vojta via Claim 6, (1.2), (1.3), finiteness via Faltings (SS pages 2 to 3)
pairs.response: Cmt-08 (C1), pages 1 to 2: finiteness is elementary; discriminant bound missing
pairs.disagreement: method of proof of Remark 5 only; both accept the statement
pairs.resolving_hypothesis: None needed: N = d(P) + n(P) >= 0 makes Remark 5 superfluous for the O(1)
pairs.layer_note: Columns other than objection and response are the assessment of this project.

pairs.objection: SS-S4: choosing a Hodge theater is equivalent to choosing a curve isomorphic to X (SS page 6)
pairs.disagreement: statement: whether the stated functor is an equivalence (choices of l and V ignored)
pairs.resolving_hypothesis: State the equivalence relative to fixed l and V
pairs.layer_note: Columns other than objection and response are the assessment of this project.

pairs.objection: SS-S5: log-link as an endofunctor naturally equivalent to the identity (SS pages 6 to 7)
pairs.disagreement: statement: invariance of the Theta-link under identifying domain and codomain of the log-link
pairs.established: asserted by Mochizuki (Rpt section 15), not proved as a numbered statement in IUT I to IV
pairs.layer_note: Columns other than objection and response are the assessment of this project.

pairs.objection: SS-S6, footnote 8: full poly-isomorphisms replaceable by one isomorphism; obvious isomorphisms cause no problem (SS page 7)
pairs.disagreement: statement: whether Theorem 3.11 survives removal of (Ind1), (Ind2) nontrivially
pairs.resolving_hypothesis: Theorem 3.11 with (Ind1), (Ind2) removed is false or trivial
pairs.established: asserted; IUT III Theorem 3.11 (i) introduces the indeterminacies but does not state their necessity as a theorem
pairs.layer_note: Columns other than objection and response are the assessment of this project.

pairs.objection: SS-S9, footnote 10: Mochizuki does not properly distinguish abstract and concrete pilot objects (SS page 8)
pairs.response: Cmt-05 (C16) pages 5 to 6; Cmt-08 (C12) page 3; Rpt (LbLV) pages 23 to 24
pairs.disagreement: interpretation: Mochizuki identifies the concrete realizations with the arithmetic holomorphic structures
pairs.resolving_hypothesis: A formal definition of the two pilot log-volumes from initial Theta-data
pairs.established: defined in prose in the statement of IUT III Corollary 3.12, pages 173 to 174
pairs.layer_note: Columns other than objection and response are the assessment of this project.

pairs.objection: SS-S10, SS-S11, footnote 12: canonical (identity) choice of Theta-link; Theorem 3.11 becomes trivial (SS page 9)
pairs.response: Rpt (SSId), (SSId1), (SSId2), (ThetaCR-dagger), (SSIdFs) pages 15 to 16; (SSIdEx), (ModEll), (HstMod) pages 17 to 20; Cmt-05 (C15); Cmt-08 (C13)
pairs.disagreement: statement: whether Theorem 3.11 applies to the id-version
pairs.resolving_hypothesis: (ThetaCR) as an explicit hypothesis of Theorem 3.11
pairs.established: asserted in Rpt sections 9 and 10; not isolated as a hypothesis in the statement of Theorem 3.11 as read for this task
pairs.layer_note: Columns other than objection and response are the assessment of this project.

pairs.objection: SS-13: all copies of R must be consistently identified; the hexagon must commute (SS pages 9 to 10)
pairs.disagreement: interpretation of Step (xi): Mochizuki says no loop occurs, only one container with one log-volume
pairs.resolving_hypothesis: The output possibilities and the q-pilot representation lie in a single container with a single log-volume function
pairs.established: asserted in Step (xi-d), IUT III page 183; depends on Theorem 3.11 and Remark 3.9.5
pairs.layer_note: Columns other than objection and response are the assessment of this project.

pairs.objection: SS-14: inserting j^2 gives monodromy j^2 (SS page 10)
pairs.disagreement: both accept (AD) inside one ring structure; they disagree whether Step (xi) forms the loop
pairs.resolving_hypothesis: Distinct labels for the holomorphic structures on the two sides of the Theta-link, with the comparison made only through Theorem 3.11
pairs.established: IUT III Step (xi-a) and Remark 3.12.2 (c-itw) assert it
pairs.layer_note: Columns other than objection and response are the assessment of this project.

pairs.objection: SS-9, SS-15: with consistent identifications, (1.5) must be replaced by (1.6), giving 0 <= d(P) (SS pages 4, 10)
pairs.response: Rpt (SSAD), (SSADFs) page 23, (MlLV) page 24; Cmt-08 (C14) (Lin) page 4; IUT III Remark 3.12.2 toy models pages 189 to 191
pairs.disagreement: statement: whether the log-volume of the holomorphic hull relates to the Theta-pilot's linearly (hypothesis (Lin))
pairs.resolving_hypothesis: (Lin) for the relevant pair of log-volumes, or its failure in the specific form needed by Step (xi-f)
pairs.established: neither established in a checked form; (Ind3) upper bound: IUT III Theorem 3.11 (ii), Proposition 3.9, not verified here
pairs.layer_note: Columns other than objection and response are the assessment of this project.

pairs.objection: SS-16: blurring must be by a factor of at least O(l^2), making the inequality useless (SS page 10)
pairs.disagreement: statement about the size and form of the effect of the indeterminacies
pairs.resolving_hypothesis: A quantitative bound on the effect of (Ind1), (Ind2), (Ind3) on log-volumes, compared with l(l+1)/12
pairs.established: IUT IV Proposition 1.2 and Theorem 1.10 contain the estimates; not read in this task
pairs.layer_note: Columns other than objection and response are the assessment of this project.

pairs.objection: SS section 2.1 excuses (2) to (4) (SS pages 4 to 5)
pairs.disagreement: about the discussions, not a mathematical statement
pairs.layer_note: Columns other than objection and response are the assessment of this project.
